C175.name: Geita Town Council
C175.documented: Lake Victoria floods and large waves, heavy rain, mining accidents in nearby pits, boat accidents, and cholera

area.en: Geita Town: mining town and surrounding pits
area.sw: Mji wa Geita: mji wa madini na mashimo yanayouzunguka

risk.en: This area is a gold-mining town on the Lake Victoria basin, one of the most lightning-prone zones in Africa; open pits, waste dumps and crowded settlements around the mines flood, collapse and catch fire.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa madini ya dhahabu katika bonde la Ziwa Victoria, mojawapo ya maeneo yenye radi nyingi zaidi Afrika; mashimo ya wazi, marundo ya mabaki na makazi yenye msongamano kuzunguka migodi hufurika, kubomoka na kuungua moto.

advice.en: For those living and working here, it helps to fit lightning arresters on schools and markets, fence or backfill old pits and keep drains around settlements open. What raises the risk: building homes on waste dumps or at the lip of old pits, sheltering under trees or in open ground when thunder starts, and leaving pits unfenced where children play. Know the solid building with lightning protection that is your shelter, and the open ground away from pits and dumps that you will move to if a slope or wall starts to crack; go at the first sign, not after a collapse. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya kazi hapa, ni vyema kuweka vizuia radi shuleni na masokoni, kuzungushia uzio au kufukia mashimo ya zamani na kuweka mitaro ya makazi wazi. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga nyumba juu ya marundo ya mabaki au kando ya mashimo ya zamani, kujikinga chini ya miti au uwanjani ngurumo zinapoanza, na kuacha mashimo bila uzio pale watoto wanapocheza. Fahamu jengo imara lenye kinga ya radi ambalo ni kimbilio lenu, na uwanja wazi mbali na mashimo na marundo utakaohamia ukuta au mteremko ukianza kupasuka; ondoka dalili ya kwanza ikionekana, si baada ya kubomoka. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C178.name: Bukombe District Council
C178.documented: heavy rain and floods in the Lake Victoria basin fringe, lightning, and a marked dry season

risk.en: This area mixes artisanal gold mining with farming; pits collapse and flood during the rains, mercury and run-off pollute water, and frequent thunderstorms bring lightning.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linachanganya uchimbaji mdogo wa dhahabu na kilimo; mashimo hubomoka na kujaa maji wakati wa mvua, zebaki na maji yanayotiririka huchafua vyanzo vya maji, na ngurumo za mara kwa mara huleta radi.

advice.en: For those mining and farming here, it helps to shore pit walls, keep processing away from drinking-water sources and shelter in protected buildings during storms. What raises the risk: digging pits without timbering, working them while rain is falling, washing ore in the streams people drink from and handling mercury with bare hands. Agree at each site where everyone gathers when thunder is heard or a wall shows cracks, leave the pit before the rain reaches it, and do not re-enter until the walls have been checked. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaochimba na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuimarisha kuta za mashimo, kuchenjua mbali na vyanzo vya maji ya kunywa na kujikinga ndani ya majengo yaliyolindwa wakati wa dhoruba. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchimba mashimo bila mihimili, kuyafanyia kazi mvua ikinyesha, kuosha mawe ya madini kwenye vijito ambavyo watu hunywa na kushika zebaki kwa mikono mitupu. Kubalianeni kila eneo la kazi mahali wote mtakapokusanyika ngurumo zikisikika au ukuta ukionyesha nyufa, ondokeni shimoni kabla mvua haijafika, na msirudi hadi kuta zikaguliwe. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C179.name: Chato District Council
C179.documented: Lake Victoria floods, large waves, boat accidents, heavy rain, and cholera along the shore

area.en: Chato: Lake Victoria shore and islands
area.sw: Chato: ufukwe wa Ziwa Victoria na visiwa

risk.en: This area includes Lake Victoria shoreline, landing sites and islands, where sudden lake storms capsize boats, lightning strikes fishers and landing sites suffer cholera outbreaks.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linajumuisha ufukwe wa Ziwa Victoria, mialo na visiwa, ambapo dhoruba za ghafla ziwani hupindua mitumbwi, radi hupiga wavuvi na mialo hukumbwa na milipuko ya kipindupindu.

advice.en: For those fishing and trading here, it helps to wear life jackets, keep boats seaworthy, return to shore when storms build and keep landing sites supplied with safe water and latrines. What raises the risk: going out in overloaded or unlit boats, fishing on when clouds build over the lake, and drinking untreated lake water at the landing site. Know the sheltered bay or landing you will run to when the wind turns, keep the mobile phone charged and the life jacket on, and on the islands know which high, solid building the village gathers in when a storm or outbreak is announced. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaovua na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa, kutunza vyombo viwe imara, kurudi ufukweni dhoruba inapojitokeza na kuhakikisha mialo ina maji safi na vyoo. Kinachoongeza hatari: kutoka ziwani kwa vyombo vilivyojaa kupita kiasi au visivyo na taa, kuendelea kuvua mawingu yanapojengeka juu ya ziwa, na kunywa maji ya ziwa yasiyotibiwa mwaloni. Fahamu ghuba au mwalo wa kujikinga utakaokimbilia upepo ukibadilika, weka simu ikiwa na chaji na boya mwilini, na visiwani fahamu jengo imara la juu ambalo kijiji hukusanyika dhoruba au mlipuko wa ugonjwa unapotangazwa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C174.name: Geita District Council
C174.documented: heavy rain, pit collapse and flooded mine shafts, lake-edge floods, and cholera

area.en: Geita DC: lakeshore villages and mining camps
area.sw: Geita DC: vijiji vya ufukweni na kambi za uchimbaji

risk.en: This area combines lakeshore fishing villages with scattered mining camps; lake storms, lightning, pit collapse and water-borne disease are the recurring risks.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linachanganya vijiji vya wavuvi vya ufukweni na kambi za uchimbaji zilizotawanyika; dhoruba za ziwani, radi, kubomoka kwa mashimo na magonjwa yatokanayo na maji ni hatari za mara kwa mara.

advice.en: For those living and working here, it helps to follow safe boating and pit-safety practice, keep latrines away from water sources and know your nearest safe shelter. What raises the risk: putting up camps on the lake edge or beside unfenced pits, sharing one water source for drinking, washing and ore processing, and ignoring storm signs to finish a shift. Agree in each village and camp where people gather when a storm, a collapse or an outbreak is reported, and move there as soon as the warning is given, taking water and documents with you. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya kazi hapa, ni vyema kufuata usalama wa vyombo vya majini na wa mashimo, kujenga vyoo mbali na vyanzo vya maji na kufahamu mahali salama pa kujikinga karibu nanyi. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuweka kambi ukingoni mwa ziwa au kando ya mashimo yasiyo na uzio, kutumia chanzo kimoja cha maji kwa kunywa, kuosha na kuchenjua madini, na kupuuza dalili za dhoruba ili kumaliza zamu. Kubalianeni kila kijiji na kambi mahali watu watakapokusanyika dhoruba, kubomoka au mlipuko wa ugonjwa unaporipotiwa, na hamieni huko mara tahadhari inapotolewa, mkichukua maji na nyaraka. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C177.name: Mbogwe District Council
C177.documented: heavy rain, mining accidents, floods on small valleys, and lightning

area.en: Mbogwe: mining sites and seasonal streams
area.sw: Mbogwe: maeneo ya uchimbaji na vijito vya msimu

risk.en: This area has artisanal mining along seasonal streams; heavy rain floods pits and diggings, washes out access roads and spreads silt over farmland.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina uchimbaji mdogo kando ya vijito vya msimu; mvua kubwa hujaza maji mashimo, husomba barabara za kufikia na husambaza tope mashambani.

advice.en: For those mining and farming here, it helps to divert run-off away from pits, backfill worked-out diggings and keep stream channels clear. What raises the risk: digging in the stream bed itself, leaving worked-out pits open to fill with water, and piling tailings where the first storm will wash them onto fields. Know the firm ground above the stream that you will move to, and leave the diggings and the stream crossings as soon as rain starts upstream; a dry channel can fill within the hour. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaochimba na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuelekeza maji mbali na mashimo, kufukia mashimo yaliyokwisha chimbwa na kuweka mikondo ya vijito wazi. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchimba ndani ya mkondo wa kijito wenyewe, kuacha mashimo yaliyokwisha wazi yajae maji, na kurundika mabaki mahali ambapo dhoruba ya kwanza itayasomba mashambani. Fahamu ardhi imara juu ya kijito utakayohamia, na ondoka kwenye machimbo na vivuko mara mvua inapoanza juu ya mto; mkondo mkavu unaweza kujaa ndani ya saa moja. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C176.name: Nyang'hwale District Council
C176.documented: heavy rain, artisanal mining accidents, floods, and water contamination

risk.en: This area has many small mining villages with temporary housing; pit collapse, lightning, fire and contaminated water are common, especially in the rainy season.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina vijiji vingi vidogo vya uchimbaji vyenye makazi ya muda; kubomoka kwa mashimo, radi, moto na maji machafu ni kawaida, hasa wakati wa mvua.

advice.en: For those living and mining here, it helps to strengthen pit walls, build shelters with safe wiring and lightning protection and treat or boil drinking water. What raises the risk: crowding temporary houses against pit edges, cooking and charging phones on loose wiring in grass-roofed shelters, and digging latrines next to the wells. Know the open, firm ground away from the pits where your village gathers after a collapse or fire, and the nearest solid building for shelter in a thunderstorm; move there as soon as the alarm is raised and account for every worker before dark. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuchimba hapa, ni vyema kuimarisha kuta za mashimo, kujenga makazi yenye nyaya salama za umeme na kinga ya radi na kutibu au kuchemsha maji ya kunywa. Kinachoongeza hatari: kusongamanisha nyumba za muda kando ya mashimo, kupika na kuchaji simu kwa nyaya zilizolegea ndani ya vibanda vya nyasi, na kuchimba vyoo karibu na visima. Fahamu uwanja wazi na imara mbali na mashimo ambapo kijiji chenu hukusanyika baada ya kubomoka au moto, na jengo imara la karibu la kujikinga wakati wa radi; hamieni huko mara kengele inapopigwa na hakikisheni kila mfanyakazi amehesabiwa kabla giza halijaingia. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
